attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.markdownDescription: The agent ID of the enterprise agent for the test.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.markdownDescription: IP address of the agent interface.

attributes.name: alert_rules
alert_type
attributes.markdownDescription: Type of alert being triggered. In multi-layered tests, this value represents the layer the alert relates to. See [Alert Details](https://developer.cisco.com/docs/thousandeyes/retrieve-alert-details/) documentation for a list of possible values

attributes.name: direction
attributes.markdownDescription: Direction for applicable alert types (eg. path trace, End-to-End (Agent) etc.)

attributes.name: expression
attributes.markdownDescription: String expression of alert rule

attributes.name: is_default
attributes.markdownDescription: Alert rules allow up to 1 alert rule to be selected as a default for each type. By checking the default option, this alert rule will be automatically included on subsequently created tests that test a metric used in alerting here

attributes.name: minimum_sources
attributes.markdownDescription: The minimum number of agents or monitors that must meet the specified criteria in order to trigger the alert

attributes.name: minimum_sources_pct
attributes.markdownDescription: the minimum percentage of all assigned agents or monitors that must meet the specified criteria in order to trigger the alert

attributes.name: rounds_violating_mode
attributes.markdownDescription: `exact` requires the same agents to meet the threshold in consecutive rounds. `auto` is only enabled for CEA and Endpoint Scheduled test rules. The default is `any`.

attributes.name: rounds_violating_out_of
attributes.markdownDescription: Specifies the divisor (y value) for the “X of Y times” condition.

attributes.name: rounds_violating_required
attributes.markdownDescription: Specifies the numerator (x value) for the “X of Y times” condition

attributes.name: rule_id
attributes.markdownDescription: Unique ID of the rule.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.markdownDescription: Name of the alert rule

attributes.name: sensitivity_level
attributes.markdownDescription: Used when `roundsViolatingMode` is set to `auto`. The default is `medium`. Higher sensitivity increases the likelihood of triggering alerts.

attributes.name: severity
attributes.markdownDescription: The severity of the alert.
Contains list of enabled alert rule objects.

attributes.name: alerts_enabled
attributes.markdownDescription: Indicates if alerts are enabled.

attributes.name: allow_geolocation
attributes.markdownDescription: Set true to use the agent’s geolocation by the web page.

attributes.name: allow_mic_and_camera
attributes.markdownDescription: Set true allow the use of a fake mic and camera in the browser.

attributes.name: allow_unsafe_legacy_renegotiation
attributes.markdownDescription: Allows TLS renegotiation with servers not supporting RFC 5746. Default Set to true to allow unsafe legacy renegotiation.

attributes.name: auth_type
attributes.markdownDescription: HTTP authentication type.

attributes.name: bandwidth_measurements
attributes.markdownDescription: Set to `true` to enable bandwidth measurements, only applies to Enterprise agents assigned to the test.

attributes.name: bgp_measurements
attributes.markdownDescription: Set to `true` to enable bgp measurements.

attributes.name: block_domains
attributes.markdownDescription: Domains or full object URLs to be excluded from metrics and waterfall data for transaction tests.

attributes.name: browser_language
attributes.markdownDescription: Set one of the available browser language that you want to use to configure the browser.

attributes.name: chrome_options
attributes.markdownDescription: Command-line options passed to Chrome when running the test.

attributes.name: chrome_policies
attributes.markdownDescription: JSON string of Chrome policy settings to apply.

attributes.name: client_certificate
attributes.markdownDescription: String representation (containing newline characters) of client certificate, the private key must be placed first, then the certificate.

attributes.name: collect_proxy_network_data
attributes.markdownDescription: Indicates whether network data to the proxy should be collected.

attributes.name: content_regex
attributes.markdownDescription: Content regex, this field does not require escaping.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.markdownDescription: User that created the test.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.markdownDescription: UTC created date (ISO date-time format).

attributes.name: credentials
attributes.markdownDescription: Contains a list of credential IDs (get `credentialId` from `/credentials` endpoint).

attributes.name: all
attributes.markdownDescription: Use these HTTP headers for all domains.

attributes.name: domains
attributes.markdownDescription: Use these HTTP headers for the specified domains.

attributes.name: root
attributes.markdownDescription: Use these HTTP headers for root server request.

attributes.name: description
attributes.markdownDescription: A description of the test.

attributes.name: desired_status_code
attributes.markdownDescription: Specify the HTTP status code value that indicates a successful response. The default value accepts any 2xx or 3xx status code.

attributes.name: disable_screenshot
attributes.markdownDescription: Enables or disables screenshots on error. Set true to not capture

attributes.name: distributed_tracing
attributes.markdownDescription: Adds distributed tracing headers to API requests using B3 and W3C standards.

attributes.name: dns_override
attributes.markdownDescription: IP address to use for DNS override.

attributes.name: download_limit
attributes.markdownDescription: Specifies maximum number of bytes to download from the target object.

attributes.name: emulated_device_id
attributes.markdownDescription: ID of the emulated device, if specified when the test was created.

attributes.name: enabled
attributes.markdownDescription: Test is enabled.

attributes.name: fixed_packet_rate
attributes.markdownDescription: Sets packets rate sent to measure the network in packets per second.

attributes.name: follow_redirects
attributes.markdownDescription: To disable following HTTP/301 or HTTP/302 redirect directives, set this parameter to `false`.

attributes.name: http_target_time
attributes.markdownDescription: Target time for HTTP server completion, specified in milliseconds.

attributes.name: http_time_limit
attributes.markdownDescription: HTTP time limit in seconds.

attributes.name: http_version
attributes.markdownDescription: HTTP protocol version. Set to '2' to prefer HTTP/2, or '1' to use only HTTP/1.1.

attributes.name: identify_agent_traffic_with_user_agent
attributes.markdownDescription:
Determines how agent traffic is identified:

* `false`: Adds the `x-thousandeyes-agent: yes` header.
* `true`: Appends `(ThousandEyes Agent)` to the `user-agent` header.

For more information, see [Notes on Agent ID Strategy](https://docs.thousandeyes.com/product-documentation/browser-synthetics/test-settings-page-load-transaction#notes-on-agent-id-strategy).

attributes.name: include_headers
attributes.markdownDescription: Set to `true` to capture response headers for objects loaded by the test.

attributes.name: interval
attributes.markdownDescription:
Interval between test runs in seconds.

Documented intervals, in seconds: `60`, `120`, `300`, `600`, `900`, `1800`, `3600`.

attributes.name: labels
is_builtin
attributes.markdownDescription: Value indicating if the label in question is BuiltIn (Account Admin, Organization Admin, Regular User).

attributes.name: label_id
attributes.markdownDescription: Label ID.

attributes.name: name
attributes.markdownDescription: Name of the label.
Labels to which the test is assigned. This field is not returned for Instant Tests.

attributes.name: live_share
attributes.markdownDescription: Indicates if the test is shared with the account group.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.markdownDescription: User that modified the test.

attributes.name: modified_date
attributes.markdownDescription: UTC last modification date (ISO date-time format).

country_id
attributes.markdownDescription: Country ID

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.markdownDescription: IP address of the BGP monitor

attributes.name: monitor_id
attributes.markdownDescription: BGP monitor ID

attributes.name: monitor_name
attributes.markdownDescription: Display name of the BGP monitor

attributes.name: monitor_type
attributes.markdownDescription: Type of monitor

attributes.name: network
attributes.markdownDescription: Name of the autonomous system in which the monitor is found
Contains list of enabled BGP monitors.

attributes.name: mtu_measurements
attributes.markdownDescription: Set `true` to measure MTU sizes on network from agents to the target.

attributes.name: network_measurements
attributes.markdownDescription: Enable or disable network measurements. Set to true to enable or false to disable network measurements.

attributes.name: num_path_traces
attributes.markdownDescription: Number of path traces executed by the agent.

attributes.name: o_auth
auth_type
attributes.markdownDescription: HTTP authentication type used for the OAuth request.

attributes.name: headers
attributes.markdownDescription: Request headers used for OAuth.

attributes.name: password
attributes.markdownDescription: OAuth password

attributes.name: post_body
attributes.markdownDescription: Enter the OAuth body for the HTTP POST request in this field when using OAuth as the authentication mechanism. No special escaping is required. The value is saved only when `requestMethod` is set to `post`.

attributes.name: request_method
attributes.markdownDescription: HTTP request method.

attributes.name: test_url
attributes.markdownDescription: Target for the test.

attributes.name: username
attributes.markdownDescription: OAuth username
Use this only if you want to use OAuth as the authentication mechanism.

attributes.name: override_agent_proxy
attributes.markdownDescription: Flag indicating if a proxy other than the default should be used. To override the default proxy for agents, set to `true` and specify a value for `overrideProxyId`.

attributes.name: override_proxy_id
attributes.markdownDescription: ID of the proxy to be used if the default proxy is overridden.

attributes.name: page_loading_strategy
attributes.markdownDescription:
* `normal`: The test waits until the entire page is fully loaded, including the downloading and parsing of HTML content as well as all associated resources, before advancing to the next action in the transaction test script. 
* `eager`: The test waits for the DOMContentLoaded event, indicating that HTML content is downloaded and parsed, and the document reaches the "interactive" readiness state, before proceeding to the next action in the test script.
* `none`: The test only waits for the download of HTML content. Once the HTML is downloaded, the test continues to the next action in the transaction test script without waiting for additional resources.

attributes.name: password
attributes.markdownDescription: Password for Basic/NTLM authentication.

attributes.name: path_trace_mode
attributes.markdownDescription: Select `inSession` to perform the path trace within a TCP session.

attributes.name: probe_mode
attributes.markdownDescription: Probe mode used by network test, only valid when the protocol is set to TCP.

attributes.name: protocol
attributes.markdownDescription: Protocol used by dependent network tests (end-to-end, path trace, PMTUD).

attributes.name: randomized_start_time
attributes.markdownDescription: Indicates whether agents should randomize the start time in each test round.

attributes.name: saved_event
attributes.markdownDescription:
Indicates if the test is a saved event.

**Note**: **Saved Events** are now called **Private Snapshots** in the user interface. This change does not affect API.

attributes.name: shared_with_accounts
aid
attributes.markdownDescription: Account group ID.

attributes.name: name
attributes.markdownDescription: Account group name.
Contains list of account group IDs. Test is shared with the listed account groups (get `aid` from `/account-groups` endpoint)

attributes.name: ssl_version
attributes.markdownDescription: Reflects the verbose SSL protocol version used by a test.

attributes.name: ssl_version_id
attributes.markdownDescription:
SSL version options:

* Use '0' for automatic selection.
* Use '3' for SSLv3.
* Use '4' for TLS v1.0.
* Use '5' for TLS v1.1.
* Use '6' for TLS v1.2.
* Use '7' for TLS v1.3.

attributes.name: subinterval
attributes.markdownDescription:
Subinterval for round-robin testing (in seconds). Must be less than or equal to interval and must evenly divide interval.

Documented values: `60`, `120`, `300`, `600`, `900`, `1200`, `1800`, `3600`.

attributes.name: tags
id
attributes.markdownDescription: Unique tag ID.

attributes.name: key
attributes.markdownDescription: Tag key. For example, "Location" or "Department".

attributes.name: value
attributes.markdownDescription: Tag value. For example, "San Francisco" or "Engineering".
Tags assigned to the test. Returned only when `expand=tag` is specified. This field is not returned for Instant Tests. For more information, see `/tags`.

attributes.name: target_time
attributes.markdownDescription: Target completion time, in seconds. Defaults to 10. Cannot exceed the `timeLimit` value.

attributes.name: test_id
attributes.markdownDescription: Each test is assigned an unique ID; this is used to access test information and results from other endpoints.

attributes.name: test_name

attributes.name: time_limit
attributes.markdownDescription: Time limit for transaction in seconds.

attributes.name: transaction_script
attributes.markdownDescription: JavaScript of a web transaction test. Quotes must be escaped (precede " characters with \ ).

attributes.name: type
attributes.markdownDescription: This is a read only value, as test type is implicit in the test creation url.

attributes.name: url
attributes.markdownDescription: Target for the test.

attributes.name: use_ntlm
attributes.markdownDescription: Set to true to use NTLM, false to use Basic Authentication. Requires username and password to be set.

attributes.name: use_public_bgp
attributes.markdownDescription: Indicate if all available public BGP monitors should be used, when ommited defaults to `bgpMeasurements` value.

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.markdownDescription: User-agent string to be provided during the test.

attributes.name: username
attributes.markdownDescription: Username for Basic/NTLM authentication.

attributes.name: vault_credentials
secret_id
attributes.markdownDescription: UUID of the configured secret.

attributes.name: target
attributes.markdownDescription: The target setting that the credential should be used for.
List of credential IDs that are stored in an external vault.

attributes.name: verify_certificate
attributes.markdownDescription: Ignore or acknowledge certificate errors. Set to false to ignore certificate errors.

attributes.name: agents
agent_id

The agents the test runs from. Sent on create and update; the read reports assignment through its own fields, so this does not round-trip into state.
